title: In Swing (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal cricket physics
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The in-swinger comes at you from outside off
And then it doesn't
It changes its mind mid-flight
Or rather it never had your mind in mind at all
You had its

[Verse 2]
The seam is the secret
The angle of the wrist at the moment of release
One degree is the difference between
Going where you meant
And going where it was always going

[Chorus]
In swing says — you think you know where this is going
In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip
In swing says — that's already too much thinking
In swing says — you've already missed

[Bridge]
Chas watched the in-swinger from behind the rope
Didn't say much
Just tilted his head slightly
The way he does when something is working exactly as intended
And the batsman doesn't know it yet

[Verse 3]
The in-swinger is not deceptive
It's honest
It goes exactly where physics says it will
The question is whether you've done enough physics
The answer, for most batsmen, is no

[Outro]
In swing
In swing
That's my boy
